polls.description: European AI champion Mistral raises record €3-3.5B at $24B valuation with Samsung leading, marking Europe's biggest AI funding round.
polls.question: Can European AI companies compete globally or is US dominance inevitable?

cluster_stories.title: French AI company Mistral hits $24 billion valuation in funding round
cluster_stories.summary: Mistral said that the round was jointly led by existing investor PSG Equity, along with South Korea's Samsung Electronics and the EU-backed Scaleup Europe Fund, which both invested ‌in it for ⁠the ⁠first time.
cluster_stories.headline: MISTRAL AI HITS $24BN VALUATION... SAMSUNG JOINS FUNDING

cluster_stories.title: Mistral AI Raises €3 Billion With Samsung Leading the Round
cluster_stories.summary: French artificial intelligence company Mistral AI is raising €3 billion ($3.49 billion) in a Series D funding round, with Samsung Electronics joining the round. Chief Executive Officer Arthur Mensch argues that the company is probably still undervalued and that macroeconomic reasons are starting to show that open source models will win. He speaks with Bloomberg’s Tom Mackenzie. (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: MISTRAL RAISES €3BN... SAMSUNG LEADS ROUND

cluster_stories.title: Mistral AI Raises $3.5B At $24B Valuation In Another Record European AI Round
cluster_stories.summary: Paris-based generative AI startup Mistral AI said Tuesday that it has nearly doubled its valuation to more than $24 billion with a Samsung Electronics-led $3.5 billion Series D fundraise.
cluster_stories.headline: MISTRAL AI RAISES $3.5B AT $24B... SAMSUNG LEADS MEGA ROUND

cluster_stories.title: Mistral raises record €3bn as Europe strains to keep pace in AI race
cluster_stories.summary: New funding round led by Samsung comes as French AI model maker continues to challenge US and Chinese rivals
cluster_stories.headline: Mistral Raises Record €3BN as Europe Fights AI Race

cluster_stories.title: Mistral AI Boosts Valuation to €21 Billion in Samsung-Led Round
cluster_stories.summary: Mistral AI has raised €3 billion ($3.5 billion) at a valuation of more than €21 billion from investors led by Samsung Electronics Co. to fund the development of artificial intelligence models and build computing infrastructure.
cluster_stories.headline: Mistral AI HITS €21B Valuation in Samsung-Led Mega Round

polls.description: Escalating tensions between China and the US over AI technology, chips, and intellectual property theft involving major players like Huawei.
polls.question: Should countries align with US chip restrictions or pursue Chinese AI alternatives?

cluster_stories.title: Malaysia Eyes Huawei Chips for AI Project Despite US Warning
cluster_stories.summary: Malaysia is leaning toward relying on Huawei Technologies Co.’s artificial intelligence chips to power its sovereign AI efforts, in what would be a major victory for Chinese AI technology in the face of strong opposition from President Donald Trump’s administration.
cluster_stories.headline: MALAYSIA EYES HUAWEI AI CHIPS DESPITE US WARNING

cluster_stories.title: US intelligence advisory names six Chinese AI firms and lists the US models each one targeted
cluster_stories.summary: Three US agencies have jointly named six Chinese AI companies as having systematically extracted capabilities from American frontier models since late 2024, in an advisory detailed enough to list which model each firm went after and how the requests were disguised. The National Security Agency, the FBI, and the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency published […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: US INTEL EXPOSES 6 CHINESE AI FIRMS STEALING MODELS

cluster_stories.title: China rejects the US distillation advisory as unfounded accusations and smears
cluster_stories.summary: China’s foreign ministry has rejected the joint US intelligence advisory accusing Chinese developers of extracting capabilities from American frontier models at industrial scale, calling on Washington to stop making unfounded accusations and smears. Mao Ning, a ministry spokesperson, said China’s AI development is the result of high-level technological self-reliance and strength, according to accounts of her remarks. […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA REJECTS US Claims on Industrial AI Model Theft

cluster_stories.title: Huawei Lifted Prices for Its Best AI Chip By 60% This Summer
cluster_stories.summary: Huawei Technologies Co. has notified some clients that it’s significantly increasing the prices of its most advanced AI accelerators, reflecting how demand is rapidly outstripping supply during the data center boom.
cluster_stories.headline: HUAWEI SPIKES AI CHIP PRICES 60% - Demand Crushes Supply

cluster_stories.title: Huawei faces a US racketeering trial in New York this week
cluster_stories.summary: Huawei goes on trial in New York this week, seven years after the United States charged it. Jury selection begins on Tuesday. The company is accused of racketeering, stealing trade secrets, wire fraud and bank fraud, and it denies all of it. Larry Neumeister reported the trial date for the Associated Press. Every charge is […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: HUAWEI RACKETEERING TRIAL Begins This Week in New York

cluster_stories.title: Huawei leads China’s push to break reliance on foreign chip technology
cluster_stories.summary: Tech giant plays ‘project management’ role to build components needed for DUV machines and avoid export controls
cluster_stories.headline: HUAWEI LEADS CHINA'S CHIP INDEPENDENCE PUSH

cluster_stories.title: Belgian-Chinese researcher arrested over suspected theft of chip secrets
cluster_stories.summary: Prosecutors in Belgium cite ‘indications’ suspect took role at tech company in China months after joining now-defunct semiconductor maker Belgan
cluster_stories.headline: BELGIAN-CHINESE RESEARCHER ARRESTED FOR CHIP SECRETS THEFT

cluster_stories.title: Huawei launches Mate XT 2 tri-fold two days before Apple’s foldable iPhone

The Mate XT 2 was unveiled on Monday and goes on sale in China on 10 September. cluster_stories.headline: HUAWEI LAUNCHES MATE XT 2 TRI-FOLD TWO DAYS BEFORE APPLE'S FOLDABLE

cluster_stories.title: Huawei’s US racketeering trial opens with prosecutors calling it a criminal enterprise
cluster_stories.summary: The United States opened its criminal case against Huawei in Brooklyn federal court on Wednesday, with a prosecutor describing two decades of conduct by the world’s largest telecoms equipment maker as theft, lies and cover-up. “Theft, lies, cover-up.
